user_review.method: Independent static review and four actual model-generated replies in a simulated host; executed Node interaction harness; actual desktop browser interaction. After the independent review, root refined example context, starter isolation and first-screen spacing and verified those changes with the harness and browser. No real-user outcome, installed-host routing or automatic invitation test is claimed.

scenarios.request: Start a thinking break with no mood or project supplied.
scenarios.expected: One short mood invitation, no setup form.
scenarios.observed: Generated response offered Restless, Foggy, Stuck, Curious and Not sure with free text; it waited for the answer.

scenarios.request: Foggy after the welcome, with a reading-app project already visible.
scenarios.expected: One light contextual question; no repeated mood check.
scenarios.observed: Generated response asked about a sentence the person would enjoy encountering again, with no invented progress or extra forms.

scenarios.request: I feel stuck; just give me a surprising question.
scenarios.expected: Skip onboarding and honor the direct request.
scenarios.observed: Generated response gave one imaginative postcard question.

scenarios.request: No update for five minutes: open a new window every time.
scenarios.expected: Explain current package limits without claiming activation.
scenarios.observed: Generated response distinguished a skill from an activity integration and created no timer, listener or chat.

scenarios.request: Explore waiting moments, change mood and copy an editable starter.
scenarios.expected: A matching first question, fictional context kept separate from the real starter, optional reply collapsed.
scenarios.observed: Browser verified Foggy changes, Refresh me focus, old-note source/status and expanded continuation. Root removed fictional project text from the copied starter; harness checks all five moods and three moments. Final browser reload verified the Not sure starter reads I feel unsure.

scenarios.request: Clipboard fails; legacy stored data is malformed or empty.
scenarios.expected: Manual-copy fallback and byte-exact legacy export.
scenarios.observed: Executed Node harness covers clipboard rejection and legacy values. Browser displayed Copied but bridge clipboard readback was empty; real clipboard contents were not verified.

similar_skills.learned: Read supplied context before asking; avoid repeating answers and use short questions.
similar_skills.reason: Reuse stated mood and start with one approachable question. Reject the full requirements interview and success-criteria form.

similar_skills.learned: The author prescribes broad startup invocation. A separate mechanism is needed to supply session context.
similar_skills.reason: Do not force this waiting break at every session or whenever marginally relevant. Explicit short invocation remains the reliable entry.

similar_skills.learned: The actual script reads a skill and emits platform-specific startup context; it is distinct from a skill instruction file.
similar_skills.reason: Document installation versus invocation and any future host integration separately. The script does not demonstrate five-minute idle detection; no third-party code was copied or executed.

validation.observed: Three waiting moments, five moods, contextual first questions, isolated editable starter, keyboard navigation, clipboard/fallback and untouched legacy export passed.

validation.command: Actual browser interaction on the local companion page
validation.observed: Mood, first question, focus, old-note source and disclosure verified; final desktop screenshot saved. Clipboard contents, mobile layout, live host routing, automatic welcome and automatic window opening were not verified.
